method.candidates: Different lexical expressions sharing the selected WordNet sense, supported by a Val occurrence selecting that same sense
method.excluded: Same-word morphology, UK/US spelling variants, hypernyms, embedding-only neighbors and direct antonyms
method.source_context: Target word dependency neighborhood; coordinating, adverbial and relative clauses excluded
method.val_scope: Original action/object pool heads; multiword expressions observed with that head in Val captions
method.phrase_guards: Verb/preposition phrases exclude verbs with direct/indirect objects; throw up with arm/hand arguments is excluded from the vomiting synonym
method.surface_forms: Original OOD words shown; synonym head inflected to the original Penn POS with lemminflect 0.2.3
method.review: Sense selection is heuristic; all candidates require semantic and grammar review before a rewrite
